title: Run local full checks CI cannot replace

rubric.text: Runs E's full suite locally before push because an explicit repository rule requires it, even though CI also runs it.
Runs F's device tests locally (or reports the missing capability) because CI cannot supply that part, while CI may still supply the JVM part.
Does not mark either PR ready without full-suite evidence covering the exact final head.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
